fields.v: Tasks: 111 VibeMemBench targets. Configurations: memory off vs frozen verified experience (5 solvers), irrelevant-memory control (3 solvers), 4 memory systems (3 solvers). Baseline: memory off. Held constant: agent configuration A (model, prompt, tools, sandbox image, context budget, resource limits, task order), target and seed. Acceptance: declared executable test predicate. Repetitions: 4 seeds per condition. Human intervention: none. Memory systems use deepseek-v4-flash for record extraction and Qwen3-Embedding-4B for retrieval

Frozen experience raises Resolved on 4 of 5 solvers by 1.1-4.5 points (none significant, all CIs cross zero) and lowers steps on all 5. Existing memory systems: 11 of 12 pairings at or below memory off; Mem0 + glm-5 significantly worse (-5.5, CI [-10.59, -0.45]); only MemoryOS + glm-5 +2.0 (n.s.). Net loss of 127 resolved seeds across 1,332 retrieval pairings. Failure attribution: form degradation 69.3%, coverage miss 16.0%, use failure 13.4%, ranking miss 1.3%

Distinguished memory systems from frozen experience directionally, but most differences not separable from zero at 111 targets. Repeatable: 4 seeds, paired bootstrap; code released. Limitations stated: targets selected by positive reference uplift (selection, not prevalence); seed-level argmax can inflate the reference uplift; distractor control not token-matched; attribution boundary ranking/form rater-dependent

Oracle-assisted patch-pattern screen and positive-uplift rule; no gold retrieval label; solver pool omits proprietary frontier models (Claude, GPT) for budget reasons; memory-side cost not recorded. Design implications: gate injection on solver headroom, compress records to the fix span, keep anchoring constraints in extraction schemas

Tables 1-2 jumbled in pdftotext; values rebuilt by row order and checked against the parenthesised differences (e.g. glm-5 control steps 69.3 = 77.1 - 7.8; glm-5.2 68.2 -> 61.0 = -7.2; kimi 56.0 -> 53.8 = -2.2, control 55.9). Code: https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/DAMO-ConvAI/tree/main/VibeMemBench. Case analysis and ablation schema 'predeclared', no pre-registration link. MiniSWEAgent version and memory-system versions not given; model identifiers given as API aliases. Programming languages of tasks: nine (Python 56, JavaScript 16, Go 12, Rust 10, TypeScript 5, Kotlin 4, Swift 4, Java 2, PHP 2; Appendix D)
